SELECT r.stock_code, r.stock_name, q.open_price, q.high_price, q.low_price, q.close_price, q.change_percent, q.turnover_amount_yuan FROM stock_selection_result r LEFT JOIN stock_daily_quote q ON q.stock_code = r.stock_code AND q.trade_date = r.trade_date WHERE r.trade_date = #{tradeDate} AND r.strategy_type = #{strategyType} ORDER BY r.stock_code LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
